name: agentdoctor
description: Tooling for auditing AI coding-agent configuration. Lints permissions, hooks, MCP servers, skills, subagents and memory files for config that is silently broken, dangerously permissive, or quietly expensive.

plugins.name: agentdoctor
plugins.description: Audit and fix AI coding-agent configuration across security, correctness, cost, hygiene and team policy. Ships the config-audit skill with per-rule fix recipes; the linter runs via npx.
